pre_condition: self.proj_dir is a non-empty string identifying an existing directory. self._messages is an initialized mutable collection supporting append operations.
post_condition: Returns self. An ELP server child process is running with its working directory set to self.proj_dir, its stdin connected to a writable pipe, its stdout connected to a readable pipe, and its stderr discarded. A background thread is consuming newline-delimited JSON-RPC response lines from the child process's stdout and appending each parsed message object to self._messages.
